proposals.evidence: Turner kāṣṭha includes kāṣṭhikā small piece of wood, Hindi kāṭh/kāṭhī and Oriya kāṭha/kāṭhi. These survey wood/fuel forms fit that family with local short vowels, deaspiration and ordinary nominal extensions. The aspirated voiced kāḍhiya spelling is held separately.
